name: Paneer and Capsicum Breakfast Toastie
steps: Mix paneer, capsicum, onion, cumin, chilli and coriander chutney.
Spread filling over two bread slices and close with the remaining slices.
Heat a non-stick skillet or sandwich press; brush the outside lightly with oil.
Toast over medium-low heat, pressing gently, until crisp and the filling is hot.
Cut in half and serve immediately.
note: Vegetarian, not vegan. Check bread and chutney labels for egg-free ingredients.
